create_slab_from_bulk_random: create a Slab object by randomly sampling a slab from a Bulk structure with max Miller index
create_slabs_from_specific_millers: create Slab objects for specific Miller indices from a Bulk structure using from_bulk_get_specific_millers
compute_slabs_enumerate: compute all symmetrically distinct slabs of a bulk structure up to a given max Miller index
tag_surface_atoms: tag surface atoms as 1 and bulk atoms as 0 in a slab using Voronoi coordination and height heuristics
standardize_bulk: standardize a bulk unit cell to its conventional standard structure using SpacegroupAnalyzer
